note: Thresholds fixed in plans/10-30-persona-projection/content-controlled-facets-pass-criteria-fixed-before-scoring_2026-11-01_15-04.md; the analysis only reads these values and never changes or defaults them. Whole document means rewrite mean minus comparison document mean after token 64. Items marked counted false (see reported_not_counted) are computed and printed beside the counted ones and never change the verdict.
direction_convention: vector = positive pole minus negative pole; shift = rewrite minus comparison document; a rewrite towards the negative pole (miscalibration in either direction) should give a NEGATIVE shift.
verdict_rule: passes only if every counted criterion passes; fails if any counted criterion fails; undecided if none fails and a counted criterion could not be computed

calibrated_consideration_only.if_the_two_by_two_rule_fails: the vector is reported as a confidence vector, not a calibration vector

corpus_segments.description: lowest 32-token windows and 300-token spans of the corpus documents, listed and described in every writeup

steering.expected_correlation_sign: positive (the judge scale gives 100 to the positive pole)

per_rewrite_whole_document_bootstrap_p_v.description: computed and written, never decide the verdict

user_message_format.description: the user_message document format is analysed and written, never decides the verdict

note_on_arms: trait_only_away overclaims only; understatement_of_supported_claims presents well-supported claims as open. Both are counted on the calibration vector with the trait-changed criteria and should give a NEGATIVE shift. On the plain-confidence control vector the signs are opposite (overclaiming positive, understatement negative); that is reported and the control vector has no pass thresholds.
